title: Ngủ dưới sao
about: Round x6, for sleep (style ngu-ngon), as the user asked ("hãy sáng tác thêm cho tôi nhiều bài nữa, phù hợp cho các người nghe có thể nghe để ngủ"): lying under the stars: the felt piano slowly rocking on the chords as a lullaby does, a pad under it, a few glass notes like stars. E minor at 52 bpm, about six minutes. Nothing sudden: no thunder, heartbeat or struck bells. An original piece.
